summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Emergent AI Teams Phase 1. 35/35 tests passed (100%). Covered: health, auth (signup/login/demo-login/me), workspace + invite, chats list/create, full message lifecycle (send/edit/react/pin/delete), AI research with real+simulated models, voting & select-best, synthesize, improve, folders + save-research, tasks with auto-reminder to assignee personal_ai chat, dashboard, and WebSocket broadcast verification.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 925 lines — consider splitting routes into modules (auth_routes.py, chat_routes.py, ai_routes.py, task_routes.py, folder_routes.py) for maintainability when exceeding 700 lines per guideline.

Duplicate message-broadcast logic in send_message, _handle_ai_command, create_research, synthesize, and _post_reminder — could be factored into a single helper that builds + inserts + broadcasts a message dict.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager.

CORS middleware is added after app.include_router(api) — works for current setup but conventionally added before routers; ALSO note allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec and silently breaks credentialed requests in browsers (FastAPI/Starlette will not send 'Allow-Credentials: true' when origin is '*'). Recommend a specific origin list when credentials are needed.
POST /api/ai/research is a long-running synchronous request (15-40s); consider returning thread_id immediately and pushing responses via WebSocket only, to avoid timeouts behind ingresses/CDNs.
send_message triggers @AI parsing but uses asyncio.create_task without storing task ref — fine for fire-and-forget but unhandled exceptions silently disappear; add a done_callback that logs errors.
TaskCreate.due_date is Optional[str] with no ISO-format validation; downstream code does payload.due_date[:10] which would crash on a non-string. Consider datetime type or Pydantic validator.
Workspace member_ids on chats can grow unbounded; no pagination on /api/workspace/members or /api/chats/{id}/messages list_messages (default 100 ok, but no cursor).
test_credentials: Demo accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified — Demo@2026 works for amit/priya/raj/neel/sara@demo.team. /api/auth/demo-login also works (Amit).
seed_data_creation: Seed runs automatically on backend startup; verified 5 chats (4 group + 1 personal_ai) exist for Amit. Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed folder/chat/task and cleanup folder+task at session end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully verified and stable. test_emergent_ai_teams.py is the regression suite — reuse it. Notes: (1) AI research takes 10-15s in practice (one full call took ~12s); (2) WebSocket broadcast on REST POST works via /api/ws/{chat_id}?token=JWT; (3) MongoDB _id is correctly excluded everywhere — checked in 6+ endpoints; (4) Reminder flow verified: posting a task with assigned_to creates a message in assignee's personal_ai chat with metadata.task_id. Frontend testing pending.
rca of the issue: Only one issue encountered during test creation: initial test used response field 'model' but actual field is 'model_key' (per ai_service.call_model return dict). Fixed in the test, not the code.
